headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 as Nifty reclaimed 25,000 in a major rally.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian equities bucked a global technology rout, posting their best weekly performance in six years.
Strong buying interest in financials, banking, and auto stocks propelled major benchmark indices higher.
Pre-Diwali buying sentiment boosted investor confidence, allowing Nifty 50 to end Samvat 2082 above 25,000.
Domestic market momentum remained strong despite weakness across global peers including Nasdaq and Nikkei.
whatHappening: In the last trading session on November 6, BSE Sensex rallied 1,718 points to settle at 81,028.
NSE Nifty 50 jumped above the key 25,000 mark, ending the session at 25,030.
This extended the rally from November 5, when Sensex climbed over 2,000 points and Nifty crossed 24,500.
The Reserve Bank of India consolidated cybersecurity rules and issued fresh safeguards for non-bank payment entities.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian markets posted spectacular gains with the Sensex soaring 1,718 points to 81,028 and Nifty 50 crossing 25,000. Equities defied global market weakness, supported by strong momentum in bank, financial, and auto sectors to register their best week in six years. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.
